proposed_next_experiment.title: Structured Memory Handoff Test
proposed_next_experiment.hypothesis: Separating project memory into decisions, failures, verified knowledge, open questions, and next actions will improve blind handoff fidelity.
proposed_next_experiment.metric: PCRB-1 handoff score and critical-fabrication count
procedure: Create a structured-state representation with five explicit memory sections.
Give the same mission to fresh models using current state vs structured state.
Run at least three blind handoff trials per condition.
Compare average PCRB-1 score and fabrication rate.
proposed_next_experiment.success: >= 10-point PCRB-1 improvement with zero increase in critical fabrications
